csv_project_name: CI Services for College and Metcalf Mobility Enhancements
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Overland Park, Kansas (sometimes referred to herein as City ) is seeking a qualified consulting firm to provide construction inspection services for the project listed above, in the category equivalent to the Kansas Department of Transportation s (KDOT) Work Category: 241 - Roadway and Bridge Construction Inspection. This project will construct a linear park with a multi-use path along the south side of College Boulevard from Marty Street to Nall Avenue and a trail connecting to the Summercrest Park Trail. The park will include two activity areas, one at College and Metcalf and one near Glenwood and College. The City anticipates additional activity areas as funding allows. The project will update the roundabout at Lamar and 110th Street to improve pedestrian and bicycle connections, pedestrian wayfinding and a trail enhancement along Outlook will also be incorporated along this corridor. This project includes Federal Funds that will require the inspector to be KDOT Certified.
